title: Give a dynamic event provider an explicit identity
goal: Choose an explicit name and GUID for dynamically emitted events; use managed listener checks to distinguish provider initialization failures, write errors and lifetime ownership.

sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins record measured artifacts.

runtime.name: .NET

language.reason: Canonical declared language mode; no preview syntax switch.

packageAssets: Framework EventSource implementation; no package route.
prerequisites: Restore/build/run the actual target with its pinned SDK; examples use nullable and implicit usings.
platforms: Windows x64 managed execution measured; no other-platform, Native AOT or native collector proof.
providers: Managed EventListener; ETW/EventPipe collection is outside scope.
stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
constraints: Use nonempty provider GUIDs and valid trait pairs; inspect ConstructionException before emitting.
Do not overlap active providers sharing an identity; dispose providers/listeners. No native collector/deployment claim.
